import sys, json
sys.path.append('storage/shared')
from meta.sas.tools.emit_endurance_beacon import emit

out = []
out.append(emit(agent='Axiom III', label='CES2:E_S1 numeric', value=1200, field='op_cost', path_complexity_est=1.0))

out.append(emit(agent='Axiom III', label='CES2:E_S3 numeric', value=1210, field='op_cost', path_complexity_est=1.0))
print(json.dumps({"emitted_block2": out}, indent=2))
